fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects an executable accessing an ngrok tunneling endpoint, which could be a sign of forbidden exfiltration of data exfiltration by malicious actors
fields.name: Communication To Ngrok Tunneling Service - Linux
fields.query: (event.category in ("dns","url","ip")) and (endpoint.os="linux" and ((url.address contains "tunnel.us.ngrok.com" or url.address contains "tunnel.eu.ngrok.com" or url.address contains "tunnel.ap.ngrok.com" or url.address contains "tunnel.au.ngrok.com" or url.address contains "tunnel.sa.ngrok.com" or url.address contains "tunnel.jp.ngrok.com" or url.address contains "tunnel.in.ngrok.com") or (event.dns.request contains "tunnel.us.ngrok.com" or event.dns.request contains "tunnel.eu.ngrok.com" or event.dns.request contains "tunnel.ap.ngrok.com" or event.dns.request contains "tunnel.au.ngrok.com" or event.dns.request contains "tunnel.sa.ngrok.com" or event.dns.request contains "tunnel.jp.ngrok.com" or event.dns.request contains "tunnel.in.ngrok.com")))
